components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Bold, dark button used for primary user actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #262d29; color: #fafcf5; padding: 16px 32px; letter-spacing: 0.05em; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; border: none; border-radius: 100px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #15803d; transform: translateY(-2px); }

narrative.overview: A light-themed design system characterized by sophisticated typography, high typographic contrast, brutalist layouts, and modern green accents. It rejects typical dark purple templates, generic SaaS cards, and lack of visual character.
keyCharacteristics: Light background with subtle green/neutral tint.
Archivo display font paired with Space Grotesk body font.

rules.name: The accent rarity rule
rules.body: The primary green accent should cover <=10% of any screen. Its rarity drives emphasis.

dos: Do maintain a strict 4.5:1 text-to-background contrast ratio using the defined forest green and near-black colors.
Do disable scroll-animations and custom cursors for users preferring reduced motion.
donts: Don't use generic blue/indigo SaaS card layouts or gradient text overlays.
Don't use thick left-side borders as accent decorators on cards.
